title: Wednesday 25 November summary
text:
Good morning, it is Wednesday 25 November: this is the GERICO summary.

Let us start with Yemen. The Saudi-led coalition says it has struck the Houthi-controlled port of Hodeidah and several targets in the north of the country. The Houthi spokesman is threatening to strike Jeddah and other Saudi ports on the Red Sea. The day before, according to Saudi authorities, a drone had struck the tallest tower in Riyadh and injured at least eleven people.

Still in the Middle East, Iran has ordered the Strait of Hormuz to be kept closed. Qatar is working to bring the United States and Iran back to the negotiating table. Trump says the war is funded until January.

In Ukraine, Russian President Putin said that retaliation for attacks on refineries is inevitable. Overnight, new Ukrainian drones reportedly hit two refineries in the Samara region. A Russian attack on Odesa killed two people.

In the United States, a New York jury found Huawei guilty of theft of trade secrets and bank fraud. It acquitted it of the charge of racketeering. The company will appeal.

Moving on to the markets. Yesterday Wall Street closed mixed. The Dow Jones rose by 0.86%, the S&P 500 fell by 0.5% and the Nasdaq by around 1.5%. Nvidia lost 7.4%, following Monday's rise linked to the return of Jensen Huang.

The decline in tech stocks reached Asia. Tokyo opened down 0.36%. SoftBank lost 15%, while Samsung and SK Hynix fell by more than 8%. According to one analyst, doubts about artificial intelligence spending beyond 2027 are weighing on performance.

In Europe yesterday Piazza Affari closed down 1.84%. ST and Prysmian weighed, falling by more than 10%. The spread between BTPs and Bunds closed at 109 points. European gas is at 92 euros per megawatt hour.

We have no verified data from this morning for gold, oil and foreign exchange.

Today's appointments. At 14:30, in the United States, third-quarter gross domestic product is released, expected at 3.5%, and the PCE price index, expected at 0.3%. At 16:30 crude oil inventories, and at 20:00 the Federal Reserve's Beige Book.

The full stories, with sources, are on GERICO. Not investment advice.
